articles.title: Built to hunt enemies in water, Navy’s new warship INS Mangrol armed with sonar, torpedoes and rockets commissioned near Mumbai coast to counter submarine threats
articles.summary: The Indian Navy has commissioned INS Mangrol, the third Mahe-class Anti-Submarine Warfare (ASW) Shallow Water Craft, at the Naval Dockyard in Mumbai. Built by Cochin Shipyard, this indigenous warship strengthens the Navy's capabilities in coastal defence and anti-submarine operations, crucial for safeguarding India's maritime interests. It signifies a vital step in naval modernization and self-reliance.

articles.title: What happens if you go too deep in the ocean?
articles.summary: Deep ocean exploration is highly perilous, with immense pressure capable of crushing vessels. Divers face severe physiological risks like nitrogen narcosis and oxygen toxicity. These dangers underscore the critical need for specialized equipment and rigorous preparation, highlighting the significant scientific and technological challenges in venturing into the ocean's extreme, unforgiving environments.
